mapper.select: SELECT k.kb_id, COUNT(*) AS total FROM public.knowledge_chunk_values k WHERE k.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND k.kb_id IN #{kbId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.nw_knowledge_documents d WHERE d.tenant_id = k.tenant_id AND d.kb_id = k.kb_id AND d.id = k.document_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.current_source_version = k.source_version ) GROUP BY k.kb_id
